overview: Brick-built, display-scale “Jedi in white” character inspired by the reference: a compact figure with white outfit detailing, tan/blond hair silhouette, and a bright blue lightsaber held in front. Build as a simple, sturdy statue with 6–8-stud-wide body and oversized saber for readability.

subassemblies.name: Feet + Lower Legs (stance base)
subassemblies.description: Two blocky feet and shins in mostly white with a few tan/DBG accents to suggest the boot/crease lines. Designed to stand independently and support the torso. Keep legs slightly apart like the reference pose.
subassemblies.image_location: Bottom of the image (both feet and lower legs).

subassemblies.name: Upper Legs / Hips (belt anchor)
subassemblies.description: A compact hip block connecting both legs; integrate a belt line using reddish-brown/red elements across the front. Provide a strong studded top surface for the torso to lock onto.

subassemblies.name: Torso / Robe Jacket Block
subassemblies.description: Main chest and back in white with small dark accents (black/DBG) to hint at the robe opening. Build as a rectangular core with a slightly tapered front using plates/tiles for clean surfaces.

subassemblies.name: Arms (two forearms crossed-forward)
subassemblies.description: Two white arms mounted to the torso sides and angled toward the center to mimic the two-handed grip. Use small hinge/clip-like solutions from available modified parts where possible; otherwise, build stepped plate arms that meet at the hands.
subassemblies.image_location: Mid-right and mid-left, converging in front of the chest (hands holding saber).

subassemblies.name: Hands / Saber Grip Hub
subassemblies.description: A compact central connector where both arms meet; build a chunky cylindrical/stacked hilt core in light bluish gray/dark bluish gray with a bit of metallic look via light gray layering. This hub also reinforces arm alignment.
subassemblies.image_location: Right-center foreground (the gray hilt between hands).

subassemblies.name: Lightsaber Blade
subassemblies.description: A long, straight blue/cyan-looking blade approximated with trans-clear pieces backed by blue/medium-azure/dark-azure plates/tiles, or a solid blue beam if trans parts are insufficient. Keep it slightly longer than the figure’s torso-to-head height for the heroic look.

subassemblies.name: Neck + Head Block
subassemblies.description: A light skin-toned head approximation using tan/medium nougat/yellowish elements as available, with a simple face suggestion via minimal dark details (optional). Keep it 2–3 studs wide for a minifig-like proportion atop the torso.

subassemblies.name: Hair / Blond Cap
subassemblies.description: A rounded, layered hair silhouette in tan/yellow/medium nougat, using curved/angled pieces where possible. Aim for a swept, side-part look by stepping plates and using slopes to soften the top and sides.

notes: Color matching: prioritize White for outfit, ReddishBrown/Red for belt, Light/Dark Bluish Gray for saber hilt, and Blue/MediumAzure/DarkAzure + TransClear for the blade effect.
Keep the figure’s footprint at least 6x6 studs (or add a small plate base) to prevent tipping with the extended saber.
If arm angling is limited by parts, build arms as stepped brackets/plates and let the saber hub lock them together for strength.
Use tiles on the front of the torso/legs for a clean ‘robe’ look; small dark accents can suggest the V-neck opening.
